placeholders.invalidPlaceholdersMessage: The following placeholders are not valid for {templateType} templates:
placeholders.invalidPlaceholdersIgnored: These placeholders will be ignored when the template is used.

emailGeneral.firstName: First name of the email recipient.
emailGeneral.lastName: Last name of the email recipient.
emailGeneral.link: Action link in the email (e.g. reset or verification URL).
emailGeneral.otp: One-time verification code for email-based two-factor authentication.
emailGeneral.tokenExpiry: Expiry time in hours or minutes, depending on the email context.

emailStudySession.username: Submission owner receiving this session email.
emailStudySession.link: Link to open the review in read-only mode.

emailAssignment.assignmentType: Whether the assignment is document or submission.
emailAssignment.assignmentName: Name of the assignment or study.
emailAssignment.link: Link to start the assigned review session.

emailStudyClose.username: Username of the session owner with an open session at study close.
emailStudyClose.studyName: Name of the study that was closed.

emailGeneral.username: The username of the person receiving the email. For password reset, verification, or registration emails this is the user whose account the email is about.
emailGeneral.firstName: The first name of the person receiving the email.
emailGeneral.lastName: The last name of the person receiving the email.
emailGeneral.link: The URL included in the email (e.g. password reset, verification, or registration).
emailGeneral.otp: One-time verification code for email-based two-factor authentication.
emailGeneral.tokenExpiry: Expiry time in hours or minutes, depending on the email context.

emailStudySession.username: The person receiving this email. For session start and session finish notifications this is always the submission owner.
emailStudySession.link: The URL to open the review (read-only). Used for session start and session finish.

emailAssignment.username: The username of the reviewer who is assigned to the task.
emailAssignment.assignmentType: How the work is assigned: "document" (review by document) or "submission" (review by submission).
emailAssignment.assignmentName: The name of the assignment or study the reviewer is assigned to.
emailAssignment.link: The URL for the reviewer to open and start their review session. They must use this link to begin the assigned task.

emailStudyClose.username: The username of the session owner who had an open session when the study was closed.
emailStudyClose.studyName: The name of the study that was closed.

emailSubmissionUpload.username: The person receiving this email (assignment owner or submitter).
